# hackerone_automation (Resource)

Manages a HackerOne automation (trigger) for an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The automation code/script body.
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric ID of the organization.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the automation.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the automation is active. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `organization_id/automation_id`.
